title: The passive with se: what was banned, approved and kept

sections.content: You know the passive with *se* from B1 Unit 6: *se* + a verb that agrees with the thing it describes. It puts the action first and leaves out who did it, which suits a dictatorship's decrees and votes: *se prohibieron los partidos*, *se aprobó una constitución*.

items.spanish: Después del golpe se prohibieron los partidos de izquierda.
items.english: After the coup the parties of the left were banned.

items.spanish: En 1980 se aprobó una nueva constitución en un plebiscito.
items.english: In 1980 a new constitution was approved in a plebiscite.

items.spanish: Muchas reglas de la constitución de 1980 se mantuvieron.
items.english: Many rules of the 1980 constitution were kept.

sections.content: The verb agrees with the thing: *se aprobó una constitución* (singular) but *se prohibieron los partidos* (plural). Do not put *a* before the thing: with a person you would be in a different pattern (*se detuvo a los opositores*, B1 Unit 6).
